note: BLOCKED: it is real footage of one real event with a known zero, shown in real time (STYLE.md §1: "Real footage of one event"). "Last Train Home" is a fictional animated story: no real footage of it exists. Building this style on our own animated master would mean putting a filter over the original film (the brief forbids it), and fabricating footage that looks real would present a simulation as authentic recording (the brief forbids that too). Not substituted with a generic version.
